headline: Live Anywhere. Share Everywhere.
subheadline: Europe’s first home-sharing community for EU citizens — no rent, no bills, with community insurance included.
how_it_works_desc: 3 simple steps — no rent, no complicated contracts.
list_desc: Verify your identity, add your home, and open availability (3-month module, you can use 1 month).
book_desc: Book another verified home in another EU country. No rent. Community fund included.
live_anywhere_desc: Live, work, and explore. Reputation and gamification keep the community fair and trustworthy.
base_stay: Base stay of 3 months (you can use 1 month)
fund_desc: Simple, transparent coverage for host confidence and guest peace of mind.
fund_card1_desc: No add-ons: each subscription contributes to the community fund that covers incidents.
fund_card2_desc: Physical damage and abnormal utility consumption during the stay, subject to review.
fund_card3_desc: Annual reports on fund inflows and outflows. The community decides future limits.
faq1_a: Maintain a ≥ 1:1 ratio between months made available and used (12-month rolling window).
faq2_q: Who pays the bills (water, electricity, gas)?
faq2_a: Fair Use Policy: guests don’t pay extra bills; irresponsible consumption is penalized by reputation and may lead to suspension.
faq3_q: What if the host cancels or doesn’t open the door?
faq3_a: HomePass is a community platform, does not provide direct accommodation, and is not responsible for cancellations/access. Hosts who fail are penalized and may lose access.
faq4_q: What documents are accepted as proof of residence?
faq4_a: Lease agreement, host declaration, utility bill (≤ 3 months), or municipal certificate.
disclaimer_text: HomePass is a community platform that facilitates temporary home exchange between EU citizens. HomePass does not provide direct accommodation and is not responsible for cancellations or access failures.
account_created: Account created (demo). Integrate your auth flow (Supabase/Auth0) here.
